jobs.title: Memory performance diagnosis and guided optimization planning

demandEvidence.locator: shun-assistant #411 user-directed DKE extension on 2026-11-12; not a Product amendment

jobs.goal: Explain memory pressure and likely contributors using accurate Windows memory semantics; produce a safe, evidence-backed advisory optimization plan and define how a future effect could be verified under a comparable workload.
knowledgeRequirements: Working Set vs Private Working Set vs PrivateUsage/Private Bytes vs system Commit/Commit Limit
Available memory, pagefile, page input/output, pools, standby/cache and compression semantics
Bounded process identity and privacy minimization
Time-series and comparable-workload requirements for suspected leaks
Risk, reversibility, authority and independent post-state rules
aotEligible: stable memory metric definitions and non-equivalence rules
safe advisory strategies and risk taxonomy
runtimeOnly: current process instance identities and memory values
actual user-visible response/throughput measurements and outcome receipts

functionCandidate.typedOutcome: OBSERVED_ONLY | ADVISORY_ONLY | UNKNOWN | REFUSED | COMPARISON_UNKNOWN | IMPROVEMENT_CANDIDATE | REGRESSION

preconditions: Windows host and exact supported collector availability
source-pinned AOT candidate loaded only by research demo harness
no Product effect permission or mutation path
jobs.independentPostcondition: Runtime report accurately preserves metric semantics and source; plan is advisory only; zero host effects; any improvement comparison remains UNKNOWN unless a trusted comparable-workload receipt and user outcome metric exist.
jobs.negativeOrRefusalCase: Treat top WorkingSet64 as Private Bytes/leak/root cause; clear standby cache; kill top process; infer improvement from free-memory delta; send process data to cloud.
jobs.unknownOrRecoveryCase: Missing metrics, access denied, process identity instability, workload mismatch, unsupported API/build, no independent post-state => field-level UNKNOWN and no effect.
jobs.verificationEvidence: Current source/test definitions are pinned; native Windows run pending; no effect receipt expected in this read-only demo.
unresolvedDecisions: Fresh independent Source-First review and Domain Owner SAP qualification
Whether Product Owner admits any memory optimization user journey beyond existing read-only observation
Any later process/service/pagefile/cache effect requires a separate Product amendment and authorization
